title: Aureline M5 verified-input manifest
description: Canonical per-domain input-materialization manifest for the M5 build lanes. Names the input source class (re-materialized from source, verified cache input, pinned-digest input, unverified external input, or non-materialized reference), the build-config digest, the materialized-input receipt, the input provenance ledger, the verification authority the lane is bounded to, the artifact families it expects, the hermetic-input posture, and the re-materialization rule, so an unverified or non-materialized input never silently enters a protected lane, the build-config-digest / receipt / verification boundary stays visible before promotion, and non-hermetic inputs, cache poisoning, and unreplayable artifacts block promotion. Downstream release-center, shiproom, diagnostics, provenance, docs, and support surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a lane's input posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
